text: Cause: titled test windows (Settings, font-chooser fixtures) become key when ordered in and SettingsWindowController.show() calls makeKey(), which moves keyboard focus to swiftpm-testing-helper even under the .prohibited policy; up to 22 opaque test windows (sidebar strips at .statusBar, Settings) covered the screen. Fix (uncommitted): SettingsWindowController gets a panelType seam; tests order in only TestPanel (never key, alpha 0) via SettingsWindowController.forTesting / SidebarPanelController.forTesting. Measured on a full run: before, 3 keyboard-focus thefts and up to 22 visible windows; after, none, and only 2 small non-key windows briefly from the two window-server tests. Rule recorded in AGENTS.md Gotchas.
